title: New GTA 6 Merch Released Alongside Art Museum Exhibition
description: Rockstar releases new GTA 6 merchandise and partners with Wynwood Walls Museum for a Stockyard-themed exhibition, featuring artwork from over a dozen artists.
youtubeTitle: GTA 6 Merch Drops with Wynwood Walls Museum Exhibition
socialHook: Rockstar has launched new GTA 6 merch alongside a Wynwood Walls Museum exhibition featuring Stockyard-themed art.

sections.heading: Merch Release
paragraphs: Rockstar has announced a new set of GTA 6 merchandise, including tees, keyrings and other items, as part of the Grand Theft Auto VI Collection.

sections.heading: Museum Exhibition
paragraphs: The Wynwood Walls Museum announced in a press release that GTA VI will feature a Stockyard area based on Wynwood and will display original artwork from more than a dozen artists, with a timestamp of 2026-10-13 148, and Rockstar has partnered with the museum to provide free admission for Miami-Dade County residents through 2028.
